t: Which Nespresso Machines Can You Use Starbucks Coffee Pods In? - Tasting Table
s: October 16, 2024 - Starbucks by Nespresso capsules will also work on certain machines manufactured by the latter company's third-party partners, including, but not limited to those from Breville and De'Longhi. What is important is to ensure you purchase the right pod sizes, as original varieties won't work on Vertuo machines, while Vertuo capsules are too wide and large to fit in those made for original pods — you don't want to damage your Nespresso machine's mechanisms.
